purpose: Arm A closes the Circle gap in the C3 F-Mapper Axis-II (c, tau) grid, which covered only Swiss Roll and Digits.
Arm B and the Arm A (c=10, tau=0.10) subset supply the replicated Axis-III recovery frequencies that III-1 requires and that C5 could not provide from one Circle case and one Tripod case.

source_obligations.II-2: cover resolution and overlap quality, F-Mapper arm, unit circle
source_obligations.III-1: recovery frequencies/distributions across independent samples rather than one illustrative graph

frozen_grid.provenance: The C8 grid is identical to the C3 grid (C_VALUES, TAU_VALUES).

arms.grid_provenance: the exact C5 Tier-A configuration, so the replication is comparable to the sealed single case

frozen_configuration.dbscan_eps_provenance: The frozen Axis-III clusterer for the Reeb benchmark domains, DBSCAN(eps=0.15, min_samples=3), established by the III-1 Conventional baseline (executed 2026-08-18, CIRCLE_RESULT.json / TRIPOD_RESULT.json) and carried verbatim into the C5 Tier-A contract. It is NOT re-derived for C8 and is NOT selected by C8.
frozen_configuration.dbscan_eps_scope_note: The M6-A2 scale rule (contracts/M6A2_SWISS_SCALE_RULE_v1.0.0.txt) is explicitly scoped to Milestone M6-A2 / I-A1-Swiss-Revised on swiss_roll_with_hole and does NOT govern the Circle or Tripod Reeb benchmark domains. For the record, applying that Swiss rule to unit_circle N=1000 seed=42 would give eps=0.01193108 and to branching_tripod_y eps=0.00696442, i.e. 12.6x and 21.5x smaller than the III-1 Axis-III clusterer. C8 uses the III-1 clusterer because C8's Axis-III arm is compared against the III-1 Conventional baseline and the C5 F-Mapper case, and a different radius would break exactly that comparability. This is recorded so the choice is auditable, not silent.

seed_derivation.fcm_seed: fixed at 42 for every unit; FCM initialization is deterministic in the sealed implementation

stream_disjointness.verification: no stream_index in [17000, 18199] occurs in any released evidence stream

arm_A_axis2: membership strength distribution (mean, std, min, max, p10, p50, p90)
multiplicity distribution (mean, frac_0, frac_1, frac_ge2, max)
status distribution over the frozen failure taxonomy

specified_primary_axis3_estimand.definition: Tier-A recovery FREQUENCY across independent data realizations: the proportion of all attempted constructions whose Tier-A invariants agree exactly with the frozen same-filter Reeb reference; typed failures count as non-recovery.
specified_primary_axis3_estimand.circle_denominator: the 20 Arm A realizations at (n_intervals=10, threshold=0.10), the C5-comparable cell
specified_primary_axis3_estimand.denominator_rule: Non-convergence, coverage_gap, and every other typed failure are RETAINED IN THE DENOMINATOR. Recovery frequency is reported over all attempted realizations, with the eligible-only conditional frequency reported separately and clearly labelled. No realization is ever dropped or retried.
specified_primary_axis3_estimand.interval: Wilson score 95% interval on the recovery proportion, reported with the exact numerator and denominator

secondary_descriptive: Tier-A endpoints are additionally recorded for all 500 Arm A Circle rows, giving a descriptive recovery surface over the full (c, tau) grid. Status counts and recovery frequencies use all attempted rows; local-quality means are success-conditioned and labelled as such. This is explicitly SECONDARY and DESCRIPTIVE. No interval, no inferential claim, and no selection of a best cell is permitted from it.

failure_retention.policy: Every typed failure status is retained as a scientific observation with null metrics. Zero imputation. No retuning, no retries, no substitution of a different seed for a failing unit.
failure_retention.abort_rule: Unexpected infrastructure or programming exceptions abort the run fail-closed and are never recorded as scientific observations.

def01_compliance: The ledger `status` field is assigned directly from the real MapperOutput.status returned by the sealed FMapper.fit_transform, at exactly one call site, never from a literal. Statically audited by tests/test_def01_no_hardcoded_status.py.
claim_language: finite-sample empirical recovery frequency of specified graph/nerve invariants and branching diagnostics against the exact same-filter reference, across independent data realizations
interpretive_boundary: Threshold memberships are evaluated only on observed lens values. No continuous extension of the FCM membership cover to all f(S) is established. Circle and Tripod results are finite-sample empirical statements about these two benchmark domains only.
plumbing_probe_disclosure: A runtime/plumbing probe was executed at six (dataset, c, tau) corners before this contract was frozen (checks/plumbing_probe.py). It measured per-construction runtime and confirmed that the failure taxonomy is exercised. It was NOT used to choose n_intervals, threshold, eps, N, replicate count, or any other parameter: every one of those was inherited unchanged from the already-executed C3 grid and the already-executed C5 configuration. Per the governing plan, a debugging pilot checks plumbing and runtime only and cannot select parameter values.
